name: guesty-cli
description: CLI and MCP server for the Guesty Open API and Booking Engine API, with read-only cached-token authentication and rate limiting

scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:cli && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:node-cli
scripts.build:test-hooks: cargo build --features test-hooks && cargo build --target-dir target/no-test-hooks
scripts.test:cli: npm run build:test-hooks && node --test test/auth.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs test/io.test.mjs test/api-commands.test.mjs test/booking-engine.test.mjs test/calendar.test.mjs test/reservations.test.mjs test/update-check.test.mjs test/release-hooks.test.mjs
scripts.test:cli:node: npm run build && GUESTY_CLI_BIN=test/harness/node/guesty node --test test/auth.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs test/io.test.mjs test/api-commands.test.mjs test/booking-engine.test.mjs test/calendar.test.mjs test/reservations.test.mjs test/update-check.test.mjs
scripts.test:node-cli: npm run build && node --test test/cli-contract.test.mjs test/node-version.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:cli-spec
scripts.check:server: npm run build && npm --prefix server run check
